property_summary: initialize() must revert only when _feeRate > 5000; the mutant reverts when _feeRate <= 5000, so after a successful call the stored feeRate is never > 5000 in the reference but may be > 5000 in the mutant.
After a successful initialize() call with any _feeRate <= 5000, the feeRate state variable must equal the supplied _feeRate; the buggy version ignores the supplied value and sets feeRate to 10000.
